text:
maria_cs: Acme (CUST-7892) reporting they were charged twice for annual renewal. Two paid charges on their end, attached receipts. Need refund asap.

maria_cs: Invoices: INV-2026-1402 and INV-2026-1402-duplicate
Payments: pay_01B3A9T (2026-04-20T09:12:07Z) and pay_01B3AA1 (2026-04-20T09:12:58Z)
Amount: $12,000.00 USD. PO: PO-ACME-2026-APR. Billing email: billing@acme.com

jake_billing: Sorry about that. We normally refund the later capture back to card. Did they request card reversal specifically or a credit on account?

maria_cs: They want reversal to card. Sent screenshots of bank withdrawals showing both charges.

billing-bot: System event stream (trimmed):
`````
2026-04-20T09:12:06Z POST /internal/invoices create -> id INV-2026-1402 200
2026-04-20T09:12:57Z POST /internal/invoices create -> id INV-2026-1402-duplicate 201
Reason: scheduled-invoicer retried after DB timeout; missing idempotency-key
`````

dave_engineer: Looks like scheduled invoice job retried without idempotency key. Two invoices created and two captures. I'll patch the job to include idempotency keys and add an alert for duplicate invoice IDs. Not blocking refund.

lee_finance: Refund policy: duplicate card captures within 7 business days -> reversal to original payment method. Use refund API and tag reason "duplicate_charge" so finance can auto-reconcile.

jake_billing: Initiating refund for later payment pay_01B3AA1. Running admin refund endpoint now.

jake_billing: Admin command (internal):
`````
POST /admin/api/v1/refunds
{
  "payment_id": "pay_01B3AA1",
  "amount": 1200000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "duplicate_charge",
  "requested_by": "jake_billing",
  "note": "refund for duplicate annual renewal (INV-2026-1402-duplicate)"
}
`````

billing-bot: Refund created. id: ref_7M2YQ. Status: pending_gateway. ETA: 3-7 business days depending on issuer.

jake_billing: Attached refund id to support ticket and added refund receipt. Will follow up once gateway confirms settlement.

sara_support: I'll send confirmation email to billing@acme.com with refund id and expected timeline, include explanation that this was caused by a scheduled retry.

lee_finance: After settlement, create credit memo for INV-2026-1402-duplicate and mark revenue reversal to ref_7M2YQ. Finance will pick this up in next reconciliation batch.

dave_engineer: Action items for infra: 1) add idempotency key to scheduled-invoicer, 2) emit metric when invoice creations for same customer occur within 2 minutes, 3) backfill heuristic to tag potential duplicates. PR opened, will canary later today.

maria_cs: Customer updated and acknowledges. They asked we include a note in their invoice history saying we proactively refunded the duplicate. I'll close the ticket once they confirm receipt.

billing-bot: Gateway callback received: ref_7M2YQ -> refunded (2026-04-21T14:03:22Z). Refund settled to original card.

sara_support: Confirmed with customer at 2026-04-21T14:25Z that funds show up. Ticket resolved. :white_check_mark:
